data.long_description:
Experience refined family living in this beautifully designed and fully furnished 3-bedroom villa with a maid's room in the prestigious Jumeirah Park community. Offering generous living spaces, elegant interiors, and a private outdoor setting, this home is ready for immediate move-in.

Property Features:

⦁ 3 Spacious Bedrooms
⦁ Maid's Room
⦁ Fully Furnished with Premium Interiors
⦁ Bright and Open Living & Dining Area
⦁ Modern Fully Fitted Kitchen
⦁ En-suite Bedrooms with Built-in Wardrobes
⦁ Private Landscaped Garden
⦁ Balcony & Terrace
⦁ Covered Parking

Community Features:

⦁ Gated Family-Friendly Community
⦁ Landscaped Parks and Green Spaces
⦁ Jogging & Cycling Tracks
⦁ Children's Play Areas
⦁ Community Retail Centre
⦁ Nearby Schools & Nurseries
⦁ Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road
⦁ Minutes from Dubai Marina, JLT, Palm Jumeirah, and Mall of the Emirates

A perfect choice for those seeking luxury, comfort, and privacy in one of Dubai's most desirable villa communities.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
